description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Own the design and delivery of full-stack features for a customer-facing software platform, covering both user interfaces and backend services. Work closely with a small founding group to ship quickly, learn from user feedback and lead projects from architecture through production.
 What you'll do
 - Build core product features across the front end and back end, including dashboards, analytics views and third-party integrations.
 - Design scalable full-stack systems, from polished user interfaces to dependable APIs and deployment workflows.
 - Lead projects end to end, owning coding, release and ongoing iteration.
 - Craft clear interfaces and APIs so new users can get up and running within hours.
 - Help new users get set up, troubleshoot problems and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.
 - Partner with founders and cross-functional colleagues to propose and drive improvements.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Experience at multiple early-stage startups, ideally as a founder or founding engineer, or a long tenure at a large tech company with fast promotions.
 - Strong front-end skills with React and TypeScript.
 - Strong back-end skills with Python or Node.js, plus experience on AWS.
 - Deep knowledge of distributed systems on the backend.
 - A university degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related electrical engineering field, ideally from a highly regarded institution.
 - At least 1.5 years of experience working at a startup.
 - A collaborative style and comfort speaking up with ideas for improvement.
 - Founder-level ownership and an ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
 Bonus points
 - Background in conversational or telephony-based AI products.
 - Experience at a lead or principal individual-contributor level.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 215,000 to 290,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 Location and work model
 - Redwood City, CA, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in the office
 - Full-time
